findings.text: the severity floor is placed after the None-utilisation guard at reckon/budget.py:1229, so a reading whose headroom is known, whose account severity is raised and whose numeric utilisation is absent returns the early clear ("headroom is reported known but carries no utilisation") without consulting the floor — verified: decide() with severity='critical' and utilisation_pct=None yields held=False while state.severity stays 'critical', and none of the nine tests pins that shape — the floor's own promise "never looser than the account's severity" is therefore escapable through a missing figure, and on the preflight strand such a block degrades to a no-hold unknown instead.

justifications.durability: nine fixture-driven tests pin the four trust facts through the real preflight path — a raised severity holds (tests/test_severity_floor.py:162, :178), below-both admits (:192, :202), the input-naming holds read differently (:216, :229) and a non-gating period never holds (:244); docked two because no test drives the severity-without-numeric-figure shape, where the floor is bypassed at decide() and the preflight strand degrades to a no-hold unknown that only a scratch probe exposes.
justifications.evidence: independently re-ran the gate at the reviewed head a9a9d02 — tests/test_severity_floor.py + tests/test_budget.py gave 73 passed, 0 failed (64 + 9, /tmp/rev_sf_gate.log) and the wider deciding surface incl. tests/test_mcp_views.py gave 79 passed (/tmp/rev_sf_wide.log), and the delta-0 claim holds structurally since a5dc512 is an ancestor of the run base 90cb3c3 with the range touching neither tests/test_budget.py nor reckon/budget.py; docked one because the manifest's baseline/after figures are prose rather than the armed revision/exit/log JSON shape.
justifications.fit: the floor rides the same binding row the utilisation does — severity is copied in _effective_quota_block (reckon/budget.py:843) only off the numerically measured own window and dropped on every other horizon, uses the established RAISED_SEVERITIES vocabulary and D02 refusal (reckon/budget.py:1249) beside the threshold-status idiom, and adds the severity slot to BudgetState's dict surface (reckon/budget.py:149); docked two because the floor sits below the None-utilisation guard at reckon/budget.py:1229, so a known-headroom critical state with no numeric figure clears without consulting the severity, an ordering no test pins.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the four done-when facts are each asserted by a fixture-driven case through the real preflight path — a raised warning or critical severity on the keyed binding window holds a dispatch the ceiling alone would admit (tests/test_severity_floor.py:162), a reading below both the ceiling and a normal or absent severity admits (:192, :202), the refusal names the input so the severity hold and the ceiling hold read differently (:216, :229), and a severity the account reports for a non-gating window does not hold while the binding row's own severity is carried (:244).
justifications.scope_discipline: commit a9a9d02 touches exactly the two declared write paths — git show --name-only lists only reckon/budget.py and tests/test_severity_floor.py — the reviewed worktree is clean at the head, ruff adds no finding (reckon/budget.py 4=4 vs base a5dc512, the test file 0), and the message has a body with no plan identifiers and no AI attribution.
